name: Integrated Proteins Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Integrated Proteins Ltd is in the business of trading in various oil seeds and agri commodities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
IPL is engaged in the business of manufacturing, trading, and processing various oilseeds. There was an operational shift in the business as:
a) The company ceased operations in the solvent extraction of oilseeds.
b) In FY24, the company explored one of its main objectives and commenced trading in agri 
commodities.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.66 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.52% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -33.2%
Working capital days have increased from 64.2 days to 339 days
